items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: she remarried a man named Kitchens in Cleveland, and stayed together, as far as I know, all through the years

ctx.x: See, we broke up -- Irene and I separated in the middle thirties, and she remarried a man named Kitchens in Cleveland, and stayed together, as far as I know, all through the years, and she just passed away recently, in the past year.
